questions.subject: english
questions.text:
(a) Fill in the blank with preposition:
Poverty is a hindrance _______ our development.

(b) Transform the following sentences as directed:
Walking is the best exercise for the old (comparative).

(c) Use the right form of verb:
I have never (regret) my penny dreadful period.

(d) Substitute the following for a single word:
Murderer of one's own mother.

(e) Correct the following sentence:
Napoleon was defeated in the war of Waterloo.

questions.subject: english
questions.text:
(a) Change the speech of the following sentence: My uncle said, "Congratulations!"
(b) Re-arrange the words to make sensible sentence: Self-satisfaction, true, consists, happiness, in.
(c) Turn into indirect speech: Ahmad said to me, "What time is it? My watch has stopped." (d) Change the voice: Your conduct has surprised me.
(e) Translate into English: এতে কোন সন্দেহ নাই যে বই পড়া একটি চমৎকার অভ্যাস।

questions.subject: physics
questions.text: A bullet of mass $\frac{1}{8} \mathrm{~kg}$ is shot at a velocity of $1280 \mathrm{~ms}^{-1}$ from a 4 m long barrel of a rifle. Determine the force acting on the bullet in the barrel and the time taken to traverse the barrel.

questions.subject: physics
questions.text: The points $A(5,3), B(-2,0)$ and $C(1,1)$ are on a circle. Find the distance between the center of the circle and center of gravity of the triangle $A B C$.

questions.subject: physics
questions.text: Find the sum of the serics: $1+\frac{3}{4}+\frac{3.5}{4.8}+\frac{3.5 .7}{4.8 .12}+\cdots \infty$.

questions.subject: physics
questions.text: A 2.0 kg jackfruit is falling vertically from a tree. If the jackfruit has an acceleration of $5.5 \mathrm{~ms}^{-2}$ while falling then what is the air resistance in Newton? $\left(\mathrm{g}=9.8 \mathrm{~ms}^{-2}\right)$

questions.subject: physics
questions.text: A faulty thermometer indicates the ice point as $5^{\circ} \mathrm{C}$ and the steam point as $115^{\circ} \mathrm{C}$. If the original temperature of an object is $40^{\circ} \mathrm{C}$, then what is the temperature that will be showed on the faulty thermometer?

questions.subject: physics
questions.text: Twelve wires where each has a resistor of R is made into a cube. Determine the resistance between opposite vertices of the cube.

questions.subject: physics
questions.text: The radius of a circular turn of a railroad is $500 \mathrm{~m}$ and the distance between the two rails is $1 \mathrm{~m}$. How much higher the outer rail has to be over the inner rail for banking needed for a train running at $54 \mathrm{kmh}^{-1}$ ?

questions.subject: physics
questions.text: The power of a lens is +2 D. Is the lens convex or concave? Determine its focal length.

questions.subject: chemistry
questions.text: How much electricity is required to liberate 10 gram iodine in 1 hour from KI solution?

questions.subject: chemistry
questions.text: At a definite temperature, the vapor pressure of pure benzene and toluene is 20 KPa and 6.67 KPa respectively. What is the total vapor pressure of a solution containing equal amounts of toluene and benzene? (relative mass of benzene: 78 , relative mass of toluene: 92 ).

questions.subject: chemistry
questions.text: Calculate the mean free path of gas molecules in a chamber of $10^{-6} \mathrm{~mm}$ of mercury pressure, assuming the molecular diameter to be $2 \AA$. One gram molecule of the gas occupies $22.4 \mathrm{~L}$ at STP. Taka the temperatures of the chamber to be $273 \mathrm{~K}$.

questions.subject: chemistry
questions.text: At $30^{\circ} \mathrm{C}$ temperature and 1 atm pressure rate of dissociation of $\mathrm{A}_{2} \mathrm{~B}_{4}$ is $20 \%$; if pressure becomes double then which direction the reaction will be proceed explain mathematically.

questions.subject: chemistry
questions.text: $100 \mathrm{~cm}^{3} 0.1 \mathrm{M}$ ethanoic acid is added to $30 \mathrm{~cm}^{3} 0.1 \mathrm{M} \mathrm{NaOH}$ solution. Determine the pH of the buffer solution created. $\left(\mathrm{K}_{\mathrm{a}}\right.$ of ethanoic acid $\left.=1.8 \times 10^{-5}\right)$
